caption: Paneer tikka in the air fryer - 15 minutes!

transcript.text: Paneer tikka in the air fryer, start to finish.
Cut the paneer into big cubes and marinate in thick yogurt with the spices.
Let it sit for twenty minutes so the flavor goes deep.
Then air fry until the edges char, shake the basket once halfway.
